2608.24477.title: Dataset Scarcity Limits Robust Evaluation of Multilingual Embedding Models: A Case Study of Slavic Languages
2608.24477.paper_summary: Multilingual text embedding models enable cross-lingual transfer of knowledge across a wide range of NLP tasks, but their evaluation remains highly uneven across high-, mid- and low-resource languages. In this paper, we propose a two-dimensional framework, specifically tailored for analyzing multilingual embedding benchmarks under dataset scarcity, and apply it on the Slavic-language subset of the MTEB benchmark. The framework distinguishes between task-specific and cross-task evaluation, while jointly analyzing three complementary aspects: (1) ranking robustness, (2) model consistency, and (3) evidence strength. At the task-specific level, we evaluate the stability of model rankings under changes in ranking methodology and benchmark dataset composition. At the cross-task level, we assess the ability of models to generalize across diverse tasks within a language. To quantify the reliability of benchmark conclusions, we introduce an Evidence Strength Score that accounts for dataset availability, diversity, and robustness assessability. Our analysis reveals severe benchmark sparsity, with many Slavic language-task pairs relying on a single dataset or highly correlated benchmark collections, limiting the ability to draw robust conclusions. The cross-task analysis reveals a small group of highly transferable models, most notably llama-embed-nemotron-8b, multilingual-e5-large-instruct, and Qwen3-Embedding variants, that consistently perform well across Slavic languages and tasks. Overall, the results demonstrate that benchmark rankings and robustness conclusions must be interpreted jointly with certain notation of their evidence strength and highlight benchmark scarcity as a major obstacle to trustworthy multilingual evaluation.
2608.24477.paper_summary_zh: 多語言文本嵌入模型使得跨語言知識轉移在廣泛的自然語言處理任務中成為可能，但其評估在高資源、中資源和低資源語言之間仍然存在高度不均衡。在本文中，我們提出了一個針對數據集稀缺情況下分析多語言嵌入基準的兩維框架，並將其應用於MTEB基準的斯拉夫語言子集。該框架區分了特定任務的評估和跨任務的評估，同時分析了三個互補的方面：（1）排名穩健性，（2）模型一致性，以及（3）證據強度。在特定任務層面，我們評估了模型排名在排名方法和基準數據集組成變化下的穩定性。在跨任務層面，我們評估模型在同一語言內跨多樣任務的泛化能力。為了量化基準結論的可靠性，我們引入了一個考慮數據集可用性、多樣性和穩健性可評估性的證據強度分數。我們的分析揭示了基準的嚴重稀疏性，許多斯拉夫語言任務對應的數據集依賴於單一數據集或高度相關的基準集合，限制了得出穩健結論的能力。跨任務分析揭示了一小組高度可轉移的模型，最顯著的是llama-embed-nemotron-8b、multilingual-e5-large-instruct和Qwen3-Embedding變體，它們在斯拉夫語言和任務中始終表現良好。總體而言，結果表明基準排名和穩健性結論必須與其證據強度的某種標記共同解釋，並強調基準稀缺性是可信多語言評估的一個主要障礙。
